gloss: east side; eastern side; the East (Cold War)

definitions.explanation: The side or part of something that faces or lies to the east: the east side of a building, a street or a country. In Cold War history, {東側|ひがしがわ} also meant the Eastern Bloc, the Soviet Union and its allies, as opposed to {西側|にしがわ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{東側|ひがしがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an exit on the east side of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{東側|ひがしがわ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝日|あさひ}→朝日：23495_asahi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: The east side of the house gets plenty of morning sun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷戦|れいせん}→冷戦：31609_reisen⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧、⟦ドイツ→ドイツ：30813_doitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{西側|にしがわ}→西側：27563_nishigawa⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{東側|ひがしがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれていた→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: During the Cold War, Germany was divided between the West and the East.
